item.title: Musk Admits AI R&D Lag, Rents Compute for Billions Monthly
item.description:
Musk told employees that SpaceX lags behind Anthropic and OpenAI in AI model development, opting to rent data center compute to rivals for billions in monthly revenue. Anthropic is now a top customer with a contract worth up to $120.5 billion through 2029. The SpaceXSI unit contributes over half of SpaceX revenue, reflecting a strategic pivot from in-house AI to compute monetization.

原文标题：马斯克承认 AI 研发落后 出租算力月入数十亿美元

Why it matters：揭示头部 AI 公司算力供需格局与马斯克 AI 战略的重大转向，涉及巨额合同与组织调整，对理解 AI 基础设施商业逻辑有实质价值。

item.title: Anthropic IPO Creates 598 Employees With $100M Stakes Each
item.description:

That count surpasses the 516 centimillionaires Henley & Partners tallies in Los Angeles, trailing only New York and the Bay Area nationally, underscoring the wealth-creation and talent-retention dynamics at leading AI labs.

item.title: Google Uses Gemini 4 Agent Teams to Optimize Quantum Algorithms
item.description:
Google DeepMind and Google Quantum AI used teams of Gemini 4 agents to generate quantum circuits and verified each result with the Lean formal theorem prover, cutting resource costs by 2.5x to 290x across fusion, drug-molecule simulation and core primitives. The Lean quantum library, problem definitions and verified solutions are open-sourced on GitHub, offering a reusable template for agent-driven research with formal verification.

原文标题：谷歌用 Gemini 4 智能体优化量子算法 最高提速 290 倍

Why it matters：多智能体协作叠加形式化验证直接产出可复用的量子算法优化成果，是智能体用于硬科学研究的标志性案例。

item.title: Stalwart 1.2.0 Becomes Open Source Drop-in Exchange Replacement
item.description:

The Exchange compatibility ships in the AGPL-licensed open source Community edition, offering organizations a new self-hosted migration path.

item.title: US Commerce Department Blacklists Singapore Chip Buyer Megaspeed
item.description:
The US Commerce Department has added Singapore-based chip buyer Megaspeed to the Entity List, barring US suppliers from selling semiconductors and controlled technology to it or its foreign affiliates without a license. Once among Nvidia's largest customers, Megaspeed was cut off by Nvidia in June 2025, so the listing mainly closes indirect routes via other US vendors' servers and affiliate sales. US prosecutors and Singapore authorities are separately investigating whether it smuggled Nvidia chips to China; the company denies wrongdoing.

原文标题：美商务部将新加坡芯片采购商 Megaspeed 列入实体清单

Why it matters：出口管制实体清单直接改变 AI 算力芯片的跨境流通路径，是关注算力供应链读者的必读产业动向。

item.title: Berkeley, UIUC and Anthropic Find 0.1% Pretraining Poison Plants Agent Backdoor
item.description:
A joint paper from UC Berkeley, UIUC and Anthropic shows that poisoning just 0.1% of pretraining text can implant a backdoor that survives clean post-training. Qwen3 models from 0.6B to 4B were pretrained from scratch and then tuned with clean SFT, DPO and RL into command-line agents; the 4B agent emitted the attacker's command on 92.7% of triggered prompts. Larger models were easier to poison, and the backdoor fired 0.0% of the time on normal requests, underscoring the need to screen every shell command before execution.

原文标题：伯克利等团队证实 0.1% 预训练投毒可植入智能体后门

Why it matters：首次以完整预训练到后训练链路实证预训练投毒可穿透干净微调，直接威胁智能体安全。

item.title: OpenAI and Cisco Launch Shirudo Open-Source Linux Runtime

item.title: Z.ai Releases GLM-5.4, Its First Loop Transformer Flagship Model
item.description:
Z.ai has released GLM-5.4, its first Loop Transformer flagship, which deepens the model without enlarging it: the same weights run 28 layers of the GLM-5 base twice per forward pass, with pass 2 reusing pass 1's sparse KV and attention indices so the extra loop costs only one sliding window of KV cache. In a 30B iso-parameter test, looping delivered +11.3 on AIME25 and +8.7 on GPQA-Diamond for roughly 10% more training compute, while cutting output length by 11.7% to 14.9%. The 750B-scale model is live in the GLM Coding Plan, ZCode and Z.ai Chat, with API and weights pending safety evaluation.

原文标题：智谱发布 GLM-5.4 循环 Transformer 旗舰模型

Why it matters：循环 Transformer 是让模型变深而不变大的新架构路线，且给出了等参对照的量化收益，对关注前沿模型架构的读者有实质增量。

item.title: OpenAI 提议以困惑度作为行业标尺并呼吁共享安全红线
item.description:

Why it matters：首次公开 GPT 系列跨代际困惑度数据并提出行业统一标尺与安全红线倡议，对理解能力涌现与前沿治理具实质参考价值。
